title: Bordentown as an industrial school with an intense music program
summary: He explains that music brought him to Bordentown, where the program ran three hours a day.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: And the Bordentown School, is that the school that these biographies and these reference books call the industrial school?
They called it an industrial school, because they taught several... That means trade school, doesn't it.
Right. But the name of it was Bordentown School.

Bordentown, yes. And it just happened to be an industrial school, because they taught agriculture and things like that. But music was what got me there, because the music program was three hours a day, every day, ten
months a year. It was the best thing in the world that could have happened to me, because the music program was intense and I covered a lot of ground in just a few years.
